authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full bhrūra explicitly gives Kumaoni bhūro white/fair, Gujarati bhūrũ brown/white and Sindhi bhūro brownish/whitish. The Buksa bhuro and Kaithal bura white responses fit this documented colour family; their white sense is not silently changed to brown. Source aspiration and rhotic/vowel notation remain intact; local phonetic history and cross-IA transmission remain qualified. Exact response: bʰuɾo.
